Panel C contains a box plot (top, exempt) and a 3D bar chart of mean polyp numbers per genotype/diameter (bottom). The bar chart shows averaged values without any overlaid individual data points for each mouse, so the underlying variability cannot be assessed.
Kaplan–Meier survival curves are line plots, which are exempt from requiring individual data points.
The bar graph of relative GTP-bound Rac1/Cdc42 levels shows only mean bars with error bars, with no individual data points from replicate experiments overlaid.

The bottom bar graph of relative expression (Asef, pJNK1, MMP9) shows mean bars with error bars and significance markers, but no individual data points are plotted.
